plan: A natural photo of a wooden desk beside a sunlit barn doorway: exactly one (1) black computer mouse sits large and clearly visible in the lower left foreground on the desk, fully in view. Exactly one (1) brown horse stands on the right side of the frame, looking over a stable half-door, fully visible. No other mice, no other horses, no other animals.

A natural photograph of exactly two (2) airplanes parked side by side on an airport apron in soft daylight, one on the left side of the frame and one on the right, both fully visible, large and clearly separated. There are only two airplanes in the whole scene, no third airplane, no other aircraft. Distant terminal buildings and a cloudy sky sit softly in the background.

A natural photograph of exactly two (2) cups sitting side by side on a wooden kitchen table near a window, soft morning daylight. One cup is on the left, the other on the right, both fully visible, large in the frame and not overlapping. There are only two cups in the whole scene, no other cups, mugs or glasses. Blurred kitchen background.

A candid photo of exactly four (4) forks lying side by side on a wooden kitchen table beside a window, natural daylight. Count: one, two, three, four silver forks, each fully visible, evenly spaced, not overlapping, tines pointing up, large in the frame. No other forks anywhere. Soft blurred kitchen in the background.

A natural photograph of exactly three (3) wooden rowboats floating on a calm lake near a grassy shore, soft morning daylight. The three boats are large in the frame, spaced apart, each fully visible. There are no other boats anywhere: no distant boats, no reflections of boats, only these three (3) boats and quiet water.

A natural photograph of exactly three (3) glass bottles standing in a row on a wooden kitchen counter near a window, soft daylight falling across them. Each bottle is large, clearly visible and fully separate from the others. There are only three bottles in the whole scene, no other bottles anywhere, and the blurred background shows just a plain tiled wall.

Photograph of exactly three (3) skis leaning upright against a wooden lodge wall in a snowy mountain resort, in natural daylight. The three skis stand side by side, large and fully visible in the foreground, each separate and clearly distinct. There are no other skis, no ski poles, and no extra pairs anywhere in the frame, only these three skis. Snow and pine trees blur softly behind.

A natural photograph of exactly three (3) sheep standing together on a green grassy hillside in soft daylight, evenly spaced and fully visible, each one large and clearly separate from the others. Only three sheep in total, no fourth sheep, no other animals, with a distant fence and gentle hills blurred in the background.

A natural photo of exactly four (4) whole orange carrots lying side by side on a rustic wooden kitchen counter, each carrot large and fully visible with green tops attached. Count: 4 carrots only, no fifth carrot, no extra carrots anywhere, no carrot pieces. Soft window daylight, blurred kitchen background with a few non-carrot items far behind.

A natural photograph of exactly three (3) sandwiches on a wooden kitchen table, arranged in a single row with space between them so each is fully visible and clearly separate. Each sandwich is large and in the foreground, made with golden toasted bread, lettuce and tomato. There are no other sandwiches, no halves, no extra pieces anywhere in the frame. Soft window daylight, blurred kitchen background.

A photo of exactly one (1) round citrus fruit, an orange with vivid pink skin, from its peel to its overall color, sitting on a wooden kitchen counter near a window. Soft natural daylight falls on it. The pink orange is large, centered and fully visible. There are no other oranges and no other fruit anywhere in the scene, only a blurred kitchen background.

A natural photograph of exactly one (1) brown, golden-baked pizza with a browned crust, resting on a wooden dining table in a cozy home kitchen. The single pizza is large and fully visible in the center of the frame, lit by soft window light. There are no other pizzas, no slices elsewhere, and no extra pizza boxes. Blurred kitchen shelves in the background.

A photo of exactly one (1) pink giraffe, its whole body pink from head to legs, standing fully visible in the middle of a sunny African savanna with dry golden grass and a few acacia trees far in the background. Natural afternoon light, ordinary wildlife photograph. Only one giraffe in the scene, no other giraffes and no other large animals.

A natural outdoor photo on a sunny park lawn: exactly one (1) bright green frisbee lying flat on the grass on the left side of the frame, and exactly one (1) brown apple resting on the grass on the right side. Both are large, fully visible, clearly separated and not overlapping. No other frisbees, no other apples, no other fruit. Soft daylight, blurred trees behind.

A natural photograph of a pastoral farm yard in soft daylight: exactly one (1) green donut with bright green icing sits on a wooden fence post on the left side of the frame, and exactly one (1) red sheep with vivid red wool stands on the grass on the right side. Both are large, fully visible, and not overlapping. No other donuts, no other sheep.
